content: Awař n SIDI i dd-yusin ɣar Ḥuciɛa, mmis n Biri, deg wussan n Ɛuzziya, Yutam, Aḥaz d Ḥizqiya, ijeǧiden n Yahuda, u deg wussan n Yarubɛam, mmis n Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil.
Ḥuciɛa yejj-dd třata n iḥenjiren ɣar Xumar
Abeddu n wawař n SIDI s Huciɛa. SIDI inna i Huciɛa: “Ruḥ, awi ict n temɣart n farq-ccɣeř uřa d tarwa n farq-ccɣeř, maɣar s farq-ccɣeř nnes tezna temmurt teffeɣ zeg awarni i SIDI.”
Uca yuyur netta, yiwi Jumar, yeǧis n Diblayim, u nettat teksi s ddeyset, turuw as-dd ijj n mmis.
Xenni inna as SIDI: “Řaɣa as s yisem n ‘Yazraɛil’, maɣar cwayt n řweqt waha u xenni Necc ad xeǧṣeɣ idammen n Yazraɛil x taddart n Yahu u Necc ad qḍiɣ x tgelda n taddart n Israil.
Deg wass nni ad yiři, aqa Necc ad arẓeɣ řqews n Israil di řewḍa n teɣzurt n Yazraɛil.”
Uca teksi nettat ɛawed s ddeyset, turuw-dd yeǧis uca inna as SIDI: “Řaɣa as s yisem n Lu-Ruḥama, maɣar war arreḥḥmeɣ ɛad x taddart n Israil, war ttɣimiɣ semmḥeɣ asen.
Maca ad arreḥmeɣ x taddart n Yahuda u Necc ad ten ssnejmeɣ s ufus n SIDI, AREBBI nsen! Necc war ten ssenjmeɣ s řqews niɣ s ssif niɣ s iysan uřa s imnayen.”
Ařami tekkes uṭṭuḍ i Lu-Ruḥama, teksi ɛawed s ddeyset uca turuw-dd ijj n mmis.
Uca inna SIDI: “Řaɣa as s yisem n Lu-Ɛammi, maɣar kenniw war teǧim ɛad d řgens inu u Necc war ǧiɣ ɛad da i kenniw.”

footnotes.text: Ḥuciɛa- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘asenjem’ niɣ ‘afřaḥ’. Biri- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘anu inu’. Ḥizqiya- isem nnes ikemmřen ‘Yaḥizqiya’.
Diblayim- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘tnayen n tɣayiṭat n tazart’.
Yazraɛil- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘Arebbi ad izeǧeɛ’ niɣ ‘Arebbi ad izarɛ’ niɣ ‘aɣiř n Arebbi’.
řqews n Israil- tuɣa řgens n Israil ittwassen aqa ɣarsen aṭṭas n imejjaben n řqews.
Lu-Ruḥama- isem wanita-a ixs ad yini ‘war arreḥmeɣ’.
Lu-Ɛammi- isem wanita-a ixs ad yini ‘war iǧi řgens inu’.
